input_contract.source_offset_unit: ASCII character offset; equal to UTF-8 byte offset

spill_classification.scope: Every boundary-crossing token for every context/entity/relation span; preserve exact left and right spill strings and widths.
priority: special-token / offset anomaly if a special token overlaps a required span or a malformed offset could affect it
no spill if the selected minimal token cover adds no characters outside the semantic span
adjacent semantic characters if any spill character is Unicode letter, number, or mark
other if any spill character is neither Unicode whitespace, punctuation, nor semantic character
whitespace + punctuation if both occur and no semantic or other characters occur
whitespace only if every spill character is Unicode whitespace
punctuation only if every spill character is Unicode punctuation
spill_classification.special_token_handling: Use the sealed special_tokens_mask. Model-visible special positions do not count as source text; any special position with a nonempty source offset intersecting a required span is an anomaly.

minimal_cover_diagnostic.selection: All nonspecial token positions whose valid nonempty source offsets intersect the full character span.
minimal_cover_diagnostic.cover: The character interval from the minimum selected token start to the maximum selected token end, with exact left/right spill retained.
minimal_cover_diagnostic.coverage_test: Clip selected token offsets to the semantic span and determine whether every span character is covered exactly once; separately report gaps and overlaps.
minimal_cover_diagnostic.nonsemantic_only_diagnostic: A span is diagnostically recoverable when coverage is exact, there is no special/offset anomaly, and all cover spill consists only of Unicode whitespace and/or punctuation. This is a measurement only; it does not authorize or adopt an alignment rule.
minimal_cover_diagnostic.strict_whitespace_diagnostic: Separately count exact-coverage spans whose entire cover spill consists only of Unicode whitespace.
minimal_cover_diagnostic.adoption: No alignment rule, punctuation allowlist, tokenizer, corpus rendering, or feature extraction is authorized or adopted by this audit.

grouping.quantile_method: nearest rank: sorted one-based rank ceil(q*N); histogram implementation must reproduce that rank exactly

forbidden: modify any S01-2 or S01-2A artifact
load LFM weights or instantiate a model
extract hidden features or create feature views
fit probes or calculate representation geometry
change corpus strings, span definitions, or tokenizer outputs
adopt a minimal-cover rule or punctuation allowlist
outputs: one audit record per declared span occurrence, including each crossing token and exact spill
aggregate spill report by span type, category, template, term identity, position, and spill width
candidate minimal-cover recoverability diagnostics, explicitly non-authoritative

terminal_disposition.S01_2B_BOUNDARY_AUDIT_COMPLETE: true only after 106496 event rows and 638976 span occurrences reconcile to the sealed inputs and the audit tree seal verifies
